learning_outcomes.text: The student learns about various robotic platforms in a playful way.
The student learns about the basics of control and programming of robots.
The student learns about processing signals from sensors at various levels of abstraction.
The student will be able to build, program and run his or her own robotic product and use 3D printing for that end.
The student will have verified the knowledge in practical situations.

syllabus_topics: hands-on workshops with LEGO Spike Prime
practical building and programming of robot models
praktical workshops with other robotic platforms – Jupiter, Nico, Mikeš

assessment_methods.method: active participation at seminars and/or events

assessment_rules: Grading is based on active participation. A score of 90% or higher results in an A, 80% for B, 70% for C, 60% for D, and 50% for E. The assessment scale is 100 for preliminary and 0 for final.
